title: [Bug]:已经定义了路径，但是对话的日志生成路径还是在默认文件夹
body:
已经定义了路径，但是对话的日志生成路径还是在默认文件夹
![image](https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope/assets/63997166/22fa7571-49fa-491d-91e5-c6c137dbed12)
![image](https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope/assets/63997166/895d6d10-fd06-444f-933b-da49df47def0)

linked_prs.title: [Hot Fix] Fix the bug that the save_dir is not effective
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/_init.py b/src/agentscope/_init.py
index dff68e58..34fa88c3 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/_init.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/_init.py
@@ -162,6 +162,9 @@ def init_process(
     if runtime_id is not None:
         _runtime.runtime_id = runtime_id
 
+    # Init file manager and save configs by default
+    file_manager.init(save_dir, save_api_invoke)
+
     # Init logger
     dir_log = str(file_manager.dir_log) if save_log else None
     setup_logger(dir_log, logger_level)
@@ -170,9 +173,6 @@ def init_process(
     if model_configs is not None:
         read_model_configs(model_configs)
 
-    # Init file manager and save configs by default
-    file_manager.init(save_dir, save_api_invoke)
-
     # Init monitor
     _ = MonitorFactory.get_monitor(
         db_path=file_manager.path_db,
diff --git a/tests/rpc_agent_test.py b/tests/rpc_agent_test.py
index d7061326..321087a4 100644
--- a/tests/rpc_agent_test.py
+++ b/tests/rpc_agent_test.py
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@ Unit tests for rpc agent classes
 """
 import unittest
 import time
+import os
 import shutil
 from loguru import logger
 
@@ -159,14 +160,15 @@ class BasicRpcAgentTest(unittest.TestCase):
         agentscope.init(
             project="test",
             name="rpc_agent",
-            save_dir="./test_runs",
+            save_dir="./.unittest_runs",
             save_log=True,
         )
+        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists("./.unittest_runs"))
 
     def tearDown(self) -> None:
         MonitorFactory._instance = None  # pylint: disable=W0212
         logger.remove()
-        shutil.rmtree("./test_runs")
+        shutil.rmtree("./.unittest_runs")
 
     def test_single_rpc_agent_server(self) -> None:
         """test setup a single rpc agent"""
